item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 31/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will be windy and slightly cooler over the region. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be persistently cool in the morning and at night over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 01/01 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 21 C
R.H. range: 65 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
